subject: Vendor onboarding — PO requirements & itemization alignment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@acmedataworks.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — PO requirements & itemization alignment

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. I’ve looped in our procurement and finance leads (Lauren, Vivek) and vendor ops (Laura) so we can confirm PO-side requirements up front and avoid rework.

A few quick asks to align on scope and timing:
- Billing entity name we should use on the PO/invoice (legal entity + remit address)
- PO requirements: do you accept a PO number on the invoice, is a physical signature required, do you require specific invoice fields (tax ID, purchase order line numbers, payment terms)?
- Line-item structure: what level of granularity do you expect (per SKU, per milestone, per month)? If you can, attach a sample invoice or describe the preferred format.
- Invoicing cadence: are you able to invoice monthly consolidated, or do you require separate invoices per PO line/delivery?
- Vendor forms: please confirm the specific intake docs you need from us (W-9, vendor enrollment form, bank details).

Attached are our PO template and vendor intake form to start — they list the minimum invoice fields we need on our side. If Acme Dataworks has a legal or procurement template you prefer, please share and we’ll review.

Proposed timeline: once intake and tax/bank docs are complete we typically issue a PO within 5–10 business days. If you have hard start dates tied to this work, call them out and we’ll prioritize.

Next steps: can you confirm the billing entity + whether consolidated monthly invoicing is acceptable by end of day Thursday? If helpful, we can book a 30-minute sync.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: redwood_po_template.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: vendor-intake-form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@acmedataworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acmedataworks.com>, procurement@acmedataworks.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO requirements & itemization alignment

Thanks Ben —

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sophie —
> 
> Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. I’ve looped in our procurement and finance leads...

Quick answers from our side and a couple questions:
- Billing entity: Acme Dataworks, Inc.
- We can include a PO number on invoices; physical signatures are not required for invoices. Electronic acceptance via our procurement portal is fine.
- For tax: we’ll provide a W-9 (US entity) and our remit address.
- Line-item granularity: we typically bill by deliverable (milestone) or by SKU. We can provide a consolidated monthly invoice but would need each billed line to reference a service description and an internal project code.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices are preferred. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs separate POs per project or whether a single open PO with line items is acceptable?

We don’t have a customized PO template to push back; we’ll review the Redwood template and send a sample invoice format so you can confirm it will map cleanly into your AP system.

Proposed next step: Marcus (cc’d) will assemble a sample invoice and our procurement enrollment package and share by Wednesday EOD. If a quick call helps, we’re available Thursday morning.

Thanks —

Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement, Acme Dataworks
sophie@acmedataworks.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@acmedataworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO requirements & itemization alignment

Sophie —

Appreciate the quick response and the plan to share a sample invoice. A few clarifications from Redwood procurement/finance perspective so we can confirm acceptance:
- PO model: either a single open PO with discrete line items (preferred) or per-project POs are both acceptable. If you go with a single PO, each invoice line must reference the PO number and the PO line number (or an agreed project code) so AP can match automatically.
- Line items: we prefer grouping by SKU/service with a month or milestone in the description (e.g., "Model hosting - April 2027 - SKU: HOST-XL"). That level of granularity keeps reconciliation simple.
- Consolidated invoices: acceptable if each invoice line maps back to a PO line or project code. If you need to submit a single monthly lump-sum without line breakdown, please flag that now — it will require a manual review and may delay payment.
- Required invoice fields: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, PO line reference (or project code), description, quantity/hours, unit price, line total, total, remit address, vendor tax id.
- Payment terms: standard Net 30 unless otherwise agreed in contract.

Attachments we need from you to complete vendor setup: signed vendor-intake-form.pdf, W-9, bank details (preferred as an encrypted form). I’ve attached an onboarding checklist for visibility.

We can fast-track PO issuance if Marcus sends the filled intake form + W-9 by Wednesday EOD. If you can also confirm the go-live week (first billing month), we’ll aim to have the PO issued before the start of that month.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
[Attachment: onboarding-checklist.md (md)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO requirements & itemization alignment

Sophie / Marcus —

Thanks for the sample invoice preview (Marcus) and for confirming the billing entity, Sophie. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we’re aligned:

Agreed items:
- Billing entity: Acme Dataworks, Inc. (remit address as provided in your sample).
- PO model: Redwood will accept a single open PO with discrete line items. Each invoice must reference the PO number and a PO line number or project code to allow automated matching.
- Invoice fields: invoice number, date, PO number, PO line/project code, description (month/milestone), quantity, unit price, line total, vendor tax id. Net 30 terms.
- Consolidated monthly invoices: OK, provided individual lines map to PO lines/project codes.

Action items to unblock PO issuance (target: within 7 business days after intake completion):
1) Acme: return completed vendor-intake-form.pdf + W-9 + bank details (encrypted) to procurement@redwood.ai.
2) Redwood (Lauren/Finance): review intake, create PO in system, share PO number with Acme and account team.
3) Vendor ops (Laura): confirm vendor record setup and payment method.

If you’re comfortable with the items above, let’s schedule a 30-minute call Monday or Tuesday next week to walk through the intake form and cutover dates. I’ve included the checklist and our PO template again for convenience.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
